mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_flow.central_access_request(request_id,request_version,snapshot_hash,payload_hash,payload_json) VALUES(#{id},#{version},#{hash},#{payloadHash},#{payload}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT request_id,request_version,snapshot_hash,payload_hash,payload_json,instance_id FROM oa_flow.central_access_request WHERE request_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_flow.central_access_request SET instance_id=#{instance} WHERE request_id=#{id} AND instance_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_flow.central_approval_nonce(nonce) VALUES(#{nonce}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT r.payload_json,i.id instance_id,i.outcome,n.actor_user_id,n.on_behalf_of,n.action,n.acted_at FROM oa_flow.central_access_request r JOIN oa_flow.approval_instance i ON i.id=r.instance_id JOIN LATERAL (SELECT actor_user_id,on_behalf_of,action,acted_at FROM oa_flow.approval_node_log WHERE instance_id=i.id AND action IN ('APPROVE','REJECT') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) n ON true WHERE i.status='FINISHED' AND i.outcome IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_flow.central_decision_outbox o WHERE o.request_id=r.request_id) ORDER BY r.request_id LIMIT 20
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oa_flow.central_decision_outbox(request_id,event_id,payload_json,tenant_id,application_id,environment) VALUES(#{request},#{event},#{payload},#{tenant},#{app},#{env}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH due AS (SELECT request_id FROM oa_flow.central_decision_outbox WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND application_id=#{app} AND environment=#{env} AND attempts <5 AND next_attempt_at <=clock_timestamp() AND (state='PENDING' OR (state='RUNNING' AND lease_until <clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,request_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE oa_flow.central_decision_outbox o SET state='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,lease_token=#{lease},lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM due d WHERE d.request_id=o.request_id RETURNING o.request_id,o.event_id,o.payload_json
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_flow.central_decision_outbox SET state='DONE',lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{request} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp()

UPDATE oa_flow.central_decision_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts=5 THEN 'DEAD' ELSE 'PENDING' END,lease_until=NULL,last_error='CALLBACK_UNCONFIRMED',next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>power(2,attempts)::int),updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE request_id=#{request} AND state='RUNNING' AND lease_token=#{lease} AND lease_until >clock_timestamp()

WITH expired AS (SELECT request_id FROM oa_flow.central_decision_outbox WHERE state='RUNNING' AND attempts=5 AND lease_until <clock_timestamp() ORDER BY request_id LIMIT 100 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) UPDATE oa_flow.central_decision_outbox o SET state='DEAD',last_error='CALLBACK_UNCONFIRMED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM expired e WHERE o.request_id=e.request_id
